palettes._comment: Season palettes = luminance gradient maps applied to the neutral leaf atlas (shared by the R3F material and the Blender renders). stops are sRGB [shadow, mid, light]; strength = how far the texel moves towards the gradient (0 = untouched texture). t = clamp((sqrt(linearLuma) - 0.14) / 0.48, 0, 1); stop 0 at t=0, stop 1 at t=0.5, stop 2 at t=1.
